title: Khaitan & Co, Hengeler Mueller, Freshfields act on Persistent's $1.4 billion acquisition of Nagarro
description: Persistent Systems Limited has acquired up to 100% stake in Nagarro SE through a combination of the acquisition of 21% stake under a negotiated deal and a voluntary public takeover offer, in a transaction valued at ~$1.4 billion.Under the transaction, Lantano Beteiligungen GmbH has agreed to sell its entire 21% stake in Nagarro SE to Persistent at the offer price of EUR 81 per share.
